name: Papa Green's Lawn Care
owner_note: Public listings refer to the owner only as 'papa' / 'Papa Green' (County Advisory Board spotlight article). One negative Birdeye review from 2020 names 'Ronald Green' as the person who charges for service, which may be the owner's legal name, but this was not independently confirmed via an official bio, so the site uses the business's own public persona 'Papa Green' rather than asserting a specific legal name.
description: Full-service lawn care company in Brandon, FL specializing in weekly, bi-weekly and monthly mowing, sod installation, tree trimming, mulching and storm debris cleanup. Licensed and insured, serving Brandon, Tampa, Riverview, Temple Terrace and Hillsborough and Pasco counties since 2012.

address.source: Confirmed consistently across Birdeye (reviews.birdeye.com/papa-green-corp-lawn-care-156226755843695, own JSON-LD block), Chamber of Commerce directory listing, and County Advisory Board spotlight article. Matches the address assigned in the task brief exactly.
address.discrepancy_note: Several third-party lead-gen/SEO directory pages show DIFFERENT addresses for a business with the same phone number (813) 369-0824: adolfolandscaping.com lists 3137 Bloomingdale Villas Ct, Brandon FL 33511 (this page is a templated lead-gen listing reusing the same generic carousel/FAQ layout and cdn.adolfolandscaping.com stock images across many unrelated Brandon landscaping businesses; its 9 gallery photos were NOT used on this site because they read as generic templated stock photography, not verified photos of this specific business). HireRush lists Tampa Palms Blvd, Tampa FL 33647. A separate web search snippet mentions 3956 Tumble Wood Trl, Tampa FL 33613. These are typical of a mobile, no-storefront lawn care operator whose home/mailing address may have changed over the years and gets inconsistently scraped by directories. The 803 E Clay Ave, Brandon FL 33510 address was used as primary because it is the one assigned in the task brief and is the one consistently backed by Birdeye's own JSON-LD schema (which also supplies the Google place_id) plus two independent directories.

geo.source: Extracted from the sameAs Google Maps URL embedded in Birdeye's own LocalBusiness JSON-LD for this listing.

phone_source: Assigned in task brief; independently confirmed across Birdeye, Chamber of Commerce, County Advisory Board, YellowPages, adolfolandscaping.com and HireRush (all list the identical number).
email_search_notes: Deep search performed and no public email found. Checked: Facebook page (facebook.com/PapaGreenLawnCare) About section and og:meta tags fetched via a facebookexternalhit crawler user-agent to bypass the login wall (only returned title/description/profile-picture meta, no email or contact block); Birdeye profile (unclaimed, no email, JSON-LD has no email field); Chamber of Commerce and YellowPages directory listings (no email field); County Advisory Board spotlight article (literally left an unfilled placeholder '(ENTER WEBSITE OR EMAIL ADDRESS HERE)' in the template, confirming no email was ever supplied to that directory either); HireRush profile (contact is a 'Send message' form only, no visible address); adolfolandscaping.com and simplylawn.com directory pages (no email, simplylawn is itself just a licensing-index aggregator). No Instagram bio to check (no verified account found). No owned domain/WHOIS to check (business has no website, see has_own_site below). Recorded as null per pipeline rule: do not invent an email.
instagram_search_notes: Searched 'Papa Green lawn care Brandon instagram' and variants. No Instagram account could be independently verified as belonging to this specific Brandon, FL lawn care business. Not blocking per pipeline rules.
facebook_note: Official public page, title 'Papa Green's Lawn Care | Brandon FL'. Page is login-walled for normal browsers/WebFetch/curl and for mbasic.facebook.com (redirects to login), but a facebookexternalhit crawler user-agent successfully bypassed the wall for the page's own og:meta tags: og:description = "Papa Green's Lawn Care, Brandon. 90 likes. Papa Green's Lawn Care is a fully licensed and insured professional lawn care business ready to take..." (Facebook truncates its own og:description at that exact point in both the page and the /about/ subpage, so the sentence could not be completed). The page's public profile picture (a before/after yard collage) was downloaded via the unauthenticated Graph API endpoint graph.facebook.com/PapaGreenLawnCare/picture and via the higher-resolution og:image URL, verified as a real JPEG, and split into two gallery images (before-cleanup-yard.jpg / after-cleanup-yard.jpg). No additional photos or posts could be retrieved beyond that single profile picture without an authenticated session.
own_site_check: Tried (per task brief) papagreencorp.com, papagreenlawncare.com, papagreenslawncare.com, papagreencorplawncare.com: none resolve (no DNS). This session additionally tried papagreenscorp.com, papagreencorplawn.com, papagreenslawncare.net, papagreenlawn.com, papagreens.com, papagreenlawncarebrandon.com, papagreenlawns.com via getent hosts: none resolve either. YellowPages lists a 'website' field of http://papagreenslawncare.localsearch.com, which is a directory sub-profile on the localsearch.com platform, not an owned domain, and does not count as has_own_site per pipeline rules. Confirmed: has_own_site = false. Only public channel is the Facebook page above.
rating_source: NOTE ON LIMITATION (per task instructions): the live Google Maps/Google Business Profile listing for this business could NOT be opened directly in this environment (confirmed JS-rendering/anti-bot block on maps.google.com and on www.google.com/maps/place/ URLs; curl and WebFetch both return blank/unrendered shells with no lh3.googleusercontent photo URLs or review text recoverable). All rating/review-count/hours data below is sourced from Birdeye (reviews.birdeye.com/papa-green-corp-lawn-care-156226755843695), which explicitly aggregates and cites Google as its review source for this listing; Birdeye's own embedded LocalBusiness JSON-LD gives aggregateRating {ratingValue: 4.8, reviewCount: 173} and the identical phone/address/hours as the task brief. This figure is independently corroborated (same 4.8 rating, review counts in the 171-173 range depending on crawl date) by Chamber of Commerce, County Advisory Board and general web search snippets, consistent with the task brief's verified 4.8 / ~172 figure. Treat 173 as the most recent Birdeye-cited count; 172 (task brief) and 171 (an earlier search-engine snippet) reflect slightly earlier crawl dates of the same underlying Google rating.

review_with_text_found.author: Le D.
review_with_text_found.text: Ronald Green charges $100 for lawn service that should be $50 a cut. Way too expensive. Terminated service after 3 cuts. I will not use Papa Green service again.
review_with_text_found.usage_note: This is the ONLY review with published body text found across every source checked (Birdeye, Yelp blocked by 403, HireRush shows 0 reviews, Facebook not accessible for reviews). It is negative. Per DESIGN.md 'verdad estricta' the site does not fabricate positive testimonial quotes to replace it; instead the Opiniones section on the live site is built around the verified aggregate rating (4.8 / 173 on Google via Birdeye) with a link out to the real Birdeye/Google reviews, rather than displaying this single negative quote as a sales testimonial or inventing quotes that were never found.

hours_source: Birdeye JSON-LD block (Mon-Sat 8:00-18:00, Sun 10:00-17:00), matches the task brief exactly. Note: adolfolandscaping.com and HireRush show a different, likely outdated or inconsistent set of hours (Mon-Fri 9-5, closed Saturday) on their own generic directory templates; the Birdeye/task-brief hours were used as primary since they are the ones tied to the business's actual Google Business Profile data.

services_note: No fixed price list is published anywhere. The single negative Birdeye review mentions a customer being charged '$100' where they felt '$50 a cut' was fair, but this is one customer's subjective complaint from 2020, not a published rate card, so per pipeline rules ('nunca precios inventados') no price was placed on the site. The site uses 'Free Estimate' as the only pricing call to action for every service, matching the precedent set by output/otechlandscaping (cta_model: quote_based).
cta_note: All CTAs (nav, hero, services, process, CTA final, floating button) point to tel:+18133690824, the only verified real contact channel with certainty of ownership. Facebook (facebook.com/PapaGreenLawnCare) is used as a secondary link for 'see our work' / social proof, and Birdeye is linked for reading the full set of Google-sourced reviews.
language_source: The business's own Facebook page title/description and its one available written review are in English. Brandon, FL (Hillsborough County) is an English-dominant market compared to the Miami-Dade demo set used as the pipeline's origin. <html lang="en"> is the default with a full Spanish data-es translation on every text node per DESIGN.md Multilenguaje section (Florida's broader market still justifies full Spanish support).

images.verification_method: Each candidate image was downloaded with curl using a Chrome user-agent, then verified with the `file` command as a real JPEG (not an HTML error page or broken download) and checked to be over 15KB before use. All 4 larger photos (originally 1536-2448px tall, 3-3.5MB Samsung-phone photos with EXIF/GPS data) were resized to a max width of 1000px at ~82% JPEG quality with Pillow per the pipeline's performance rule, which also strips their EXIF/GPS metadata as a side effect (good for privacy, since some contained embedded GPS coordinates of customer homes).
sources: Facebook profile picture (graph.facebook.com/PapaGreenLawnCare/picture and the higher-resolution og:image URL fetched via a facebookexternalhit crawler user-agent to bypass the login wall): a single 720x720 before/after collage image of the same Brandon backyard. Split into two separate images with Pillow (top half = before, bottom half = after) since it documents two distinct, real moments of one job, not a single continuous photo.

HireRush.com vendor profile (hirerush.com/profile/leroy-g-3763, listed under the same phone number 813-369-0824, 'Papa Green lawncare'): 3 full-resolution real work photos with intact camera EXIF data (Samsung SCH-R530M, dated 2014-08 and 2014-09) plus 1 additional full-resolution photo under the profile's 'userpic' path (Samsung SM-J120AZ, dated 2017-04) which turned out to be a landscape photo (yellow house, large oak, manicured lawn), not a selfie of the owner, so it was used as a gallery/hero photo rather than discarded.
images.discarded_sources: adolfolandscaping.com/business/papa-greens-lawn-care-fl-44203/ surfaced 9 gallery images (papa-greens-lawn-care-brandon-fl-image-1.webp through -9.webp), but this entire page was identified as a generic, automated lead-gen/SEO directory template (same carousel/FAQ/related-companies layout and cdn.adolfolandscaping.com image-hosting pattern reused verbatim across many unrelated Brandon landscaping businesses on the same site, e.g. Authentic Custom Services, Florida Landworx, Magna Carta Lawn Service). Its images and address (3137 Bloomingdale Villas Ct) could not be confirmed as genuinely belonging to, or photographed by, this specific business, so none of its 9 images were used, per the pipeline rule to use only verifiably real photos of the actual business. County Advisory Board and Birdeye's own cover images are stock/generic (a stock lawn-services graphic and a generic stock photo credited '10735986_m'), also not used.

selected.desc: Yellow-stucco house with a large oak tree and a freshly manicured front lawn (HireRush 'userpic').
Overgrown, shaded backyard next to a garage/shed before a Papa Green's Lawn Care clean up (top half of Facebook profile-picture collage).
Same backyard after mowing, edging and a fresh white gravel path (bottom half of the same Facebook collage).
Freshly mowed small-house front lawn with a pink flamingo yard ornament (HireRush).
Landscaped garden bed with mulch and tropical plants along a house facade, mossy roof visible (HireRush).
A cleared pile of storm debris/tree branches on a residential street, shot from a work vehicle (HireRush).

curation_note: All 6 photos used are real, verified work photos found on the business's own Facebook page or its HireRush marketplace profile; none are stock or unrelated. None show selfies, closed eyes, text/caption overlays, or casual artist POV unrelated to the work; the one photo taken from inside a vehicle (storm-debris-cleanup.jpg) directly documents the storm debris cleanup service itself, not an off-topic personal moment, so it was kept per DESIGN.md's curation guidance. No team/staff photos exist for this owner-operated business, so the template's 'team avatar chips' block was removed rather than inventing staff names or reusing a non-staff photo as a fake avatar.
brand_vibe: Owner-operated, hands-on Brandon, FL lawn care crew running since 2012 (20+ years in the trade). Real work photos show classic Central Florida residential yards: oak trees, St. Augustine grass, mulch beds, storm debris cleanup after summer storms. Palette derived: warm ivory/sand base with a rich turf/pine green accent (distinct new hex values from every other palette already used in this repo, including the other lawn-care demo output/otechlandscaping, which uses a more olive-toned green; this palette leans slightly cooler/deeper, echoing well-watered St. Augustine grass rather than dry moss).

palette.name: papa-green-turf
palette.note: Every accent/bg/ink hex and rgba triplet in the copied template was swapped from Amani's mocha/champagne tones to this turf-green + warm ivory family; verified via grep that none of the old template hex codes remain. Distinct from mizu/amani/mare/alea/pausa and from otechlandscaping's forest palette (different hex values throughout).

build_notes: Derived from templates/light/index.html (Amani HeadSpa exemplar) by copying it whole and editing in place, per PIPELINE.md Fase 2 (never written from scratch). Full palette swap done via literal find/replace of every old hex/rgba color to the new turf-green palette (merktop-badge's fixed dark/gold colors were explicitly excluded and left untouched). Nav/section ids renamed to #nuestro-trabajo and #proceso for the lawn-care content. The 4-step 'Ritual' section was rewritten into a real lawn-care workflow (free estimate -> first visit/assessment -> mowing, edging & clean up -> ongoing maintenance) without reusing any literal head-spa phrasing. Services section rebuilt with 4 featured quote-based cards (no fixed prices, since none are published) plus a full grouped-by-category services list, fully visible with no <details>/accordion elements, per the quality gate. Opiniones section rebuilt around the verified aggregate rating (4.8/173 on Google via Birdeye) rather than a testimonial carousel, since only one review with text was found and it was negative; no positive quotes were fabricated. Team avatar block removed (no real staff photos exist for this owner-operated business). Bilingual data-es/data-en added to every visible text node plus a langToggle button in the nav (English default, matches the business's own English-language public presence, full Spanish translation included per DESIGN.md's Florida-market requirement). All images resized to max 1000px width (~82% quality) per the performance rule. Verified: 0 em-dashes, JSON-LD parses via both python json.loads and node JSON.parse, all 6 referenced image paths exist on disk, all required design-system markers present (text-shine, orb, glass, btn-3d, reveal, Playfair, merktop-badge, data-es, assets/tailwind.js, split-word, sec-num, tile-cap, cursor-ring, foot-mark, heroInner), no <details>/accordion elements anywhere, HTML tag balance checked (section/header/footer/div open=close), and the page's non-JSON script block parses without a JS syntax error via `new Function()`.
